This pathway is directly linked to Gabrb2, indicating a possible interaction between Halothane and Gabrb2 through the Glra1-Gabrb2 axis. The mechanism implies that Halothane may modulate Gabrb2 activity through the activation of Glra1, potentially influencing ion channel function. This explanation is grounded in the observed molecular interactions and their functional implications, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct effect on Gabrb2.
